# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is described with long gray hair framing a placid face that bore a kindly smile after his death. He rarely dressed up in a white collar or drove in a buggy.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Extremely shy and quiet, Matthew was famously taciturn and hated being among strangers or having to talk. Despite his oddities, he was deeply soft-hearted, indulgent, and sympathetic, particularly toward Anne Shirley. He delighted in listening to Anne speak and was always quick to take her side.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c25 P13](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0013), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Though he rarely left home or volunteered information to anyone, he drove out one day to collect Anne Shirley, being the first person to offer her the love and sympathy she craved. Despite Marilla's strictness, Matthew frequently indulged Anne, defended her actions, and took her side, listening delightedly to her endless talking. Years later, after reading an account of the failure of the Abbey Bank brought from the office, he suffered a sudden shock and died instantaneously. He was laid to rest surrounded by the old-fashioned homestead garden flowers he loved, and Anne continued to make weekly pilgrimages to his grave to honor his memory.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c10 P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002), [v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_
